# cvp_workspace_rebase (Action)

Rebase the workspace onto the latest mainline (REQUEST_REBASE).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Invoke the rebase verb on a workspace.
action "cvp_workspace_rebase" "example" {
  config {
    workspace_id = cvp_workspace.example.workspace_id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) The `workspace_id` of the target workspace.
